name: 39 (2026-11-27 evening)
what: Track B after its G2 was held: the particle-number member in the shifted gauge, a gauge-invariant comparison of the late strain, corrections
note: Release core-v0.8 is on main. Rulings: coord/DECISIONS/0039 to 0050. The shared queue calls an entry done only when its jobs completed (`nrpic-queue status`, `audit`). After git merge main: nrpic-run finish closes runs continued in place; finish and verify keep a checksum cache. Keep to the time given; every number with its run id; prediction before every new run or analysis; figures made by registered scripts and looked at; at most 6 cores.

items.extra: Extra for this session (about seventy-five minutes). Gate G2 is HELD, not signed (coord/GATES.md; coord/DECISIONS/0050; stage/G2/GATE_REVIEW.md): record it without softening. The item on three-way convergence is met for the band strain only up to a = 49; after that the two gauges differ by 5, 20 and 36 per cent at a = 64, 100, 132, and the particle-number leg exists only with zero shift. (1) FIRST, so that it runs while you work: the member of 128 cells at eight particles per cell with the Gamma-driver shift (the initial data exist; about 0.85 card-hours; priority 2; the release build), prediction first: the band strain against the member at one particle per cell in the same gauge at a = 64, 100, 132, and what would refute convergence in particle number; and the gate review's K1 (does the driven shift hold at eight per cell?). (2) Condition (a), on processors from the dumps that exist: the late strain compared between the two gauges in a measure that does not depend on the gauge (the Weyl scalar Psi4 of your wave tests' reader, or the review's rho_K), prediction first: if the 20 to 36 per cent is a coordinate effect the invariant measure agrees between gauges to within what? and what if it does not? Test the reader on an analytic field first; figure looked at. (3) The corrections the gate review lists (the particle leg is zero shift: say so in C2's evidence and the note; the gauge dependence quoted as a function of a; the stale note section VII and ladder schematic; EVIDENCE and REPRODUCE with the batch-37 runs; the pancake row under C1); the scope text with dated amendments for its two unplaced things (decision 0050 item 3); the cause of the shearing-dust failure as run is open again (the reference paper's codes at that amplitude are particle codes): say so. (4) When (1) has ended and (2) is done: judge both against their predictions, update C2 as measured, stage collect, verify, report, and send the orchestrator one line (outbox) for the second review.
